requirements.description: Remove the bool-specific include_bool handling from the masked-dtype test_plot_on_y_axis override.
Handle the boolean/include_bool case in the shared base test instead of the masked test.

label.evidence: pandas/tests/extension/test_masked.py:359-383 (after code): include_bool/is_bool_dtype special case removed from the masked test; replaced by new plot_data-based overrides. Base test not in the diff.
label.notes: Reviewer asked whether the bool include_bool handling belongs in the base test; the author said they'd change it. The include_bool/is_bool_dtype special case is gone from test_masked.py, but the base test file isn't in the diff, so I can't confirm it was moved there. The masked file now has new x/y-axis overrides expecting TypeError with NA values, which is different handling rather than a move.
